aspect: Sexual dysfunction is documented and undiscussed
description: Listed in the chemical-warfare survivor literature alongside depression and PTSD. It is attributed within the marriage to loss of attraction or infidelity, because the actual cause is never raised.
energy_note: A medical symptom read as rejection.

aspect: Numbness is experienced by the partner as coldness
description: Emotional blunting is a symptom. From the other side of the bed it is indistinguishable from having stopped caring, and it is responded to accordingly.
energy_note: Diagnosed by your spouse as not loving them.

aspect: The partner develops secondary traumatic stress
description: Living with and caring for a war-injured person produces measurable symptoms in the carer, who was not in the war and has no standing to claim anything.
energy_note: Injured by proximity, eligible for nothing.

aspect: SECONDARY - and it damages the economics too
description: The knock-on to work performance of an unaddressed intimate and marital collapse is real: concentration, ambition, risk appetite and the willingness to start anything new all fall.
energy_note: No business ever started, for reasons nobody will say out loud.
notes: Deliberate cross-link to the psychological material in assets/text/iran connecting sexual dissatisfaction to enterprise and career outcomes.
